title: Request a Show Me Fire API key
intro: A key gives approved agencies and developers higher rate limits on the public Show Me Fire API (weather, fire danger, forecasts, Burn Check and more). Tell us who you are and how you plan to use it. A staff member reviews every request, and we email your key when it is approved.
success_message: Thank you. Your request was received and a staff member will review it. We will email you at the address you gave when there is a decision.
_how_to_edit: To add or change a question, edit the `fields` list below and deploy; nothing else needs to change. The website draws this form from it, the API validates against it, and staff see every answer (with the question's label as it was when the request was sent) on the admin page. Field keys: id (unique, letters/digits/underscore), label, type (text, email, tel, url, textarea, select, radio, checkbox, number), required, help, placeholder, max_length (text/textarea), options [{value, label}] (select/radio), min/max (number), section (heading to group fields), show_if {field, equals} (only ask when another answer matches). The `name`, `email` and `agency` ids must stay: they are used for the review list and the emails.
